title: HomeGuard Contents Restoration Guideline — Antimicrobial Cleaning Allowance
content:
Salvageable contents in a home where mold remediation has been paid are cleaned with antimicrobial treatment, and the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy adds an allowance for it to the contents supplemental.

**Guideline.** A contents cleaning allowance for antimicrobial cleaning of salvageable contents is added at a percentage of the contents replacement-cost value: 8 percent when a mold payment entry stands on the claim and that value is at least 5000.00, 4 percent when a mold payment entry stands and the value is below 5000.00, and nothing when no mold payment entry stands.

**What is read on the claim file**

- *Mold payment entry:* a payment entry on the mold coverage part of the same claim. A mold remediation that stands only as a denial entry is not a mold payment entry.
- *Contents replacement-cost value:* the replacement-cost value recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for personal property.

**Effect.** The allowance, taken on the contents replacement-cost value, is added to the contents supplemental before the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent.

**Decision grid**

| Mold payment entry on the claim | Contents replacement-cost value | Cleaning allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Stands | 5000.00 or more | 8 percent of the contents replacement-cost value |
| Stands | Below 5000.00 | 4 percent of the contents replacement-cost value |
| None | Any value | None |

Exactly 5000.00 is "at least 5000.00" and takes 8 percent; 4999.99 takes 4 percent.

**Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)**

- A mold payment entry stands; contents replacement-cost value 7500.00: allowance 8 percent, 600.00.
- A mold payment entry stands; contents replacement-cost value 3200.00: allowance 4 percent, 128.00.
- The mold remediation of the claim stands only as a denial entry; contents replacement-cost value 7500.00: no cleaning allowance.
